title: HHHusher parts list
description: What's in the box as a big list on a camel band: 57px number left, name right-aligned, thin rules between, every row faded to 15%. Hovering a row brings it to full strength and a photo of that part floats beside the pointer, easing after it. Rows rise 50px into place one after another as the list enters; phones show the chosen part at full strength and the rest half-faded.
notes: the band is the theme's secondary (tan)
the floating photo is desktop only (a mouse); it shows a placeholder until you pass media
hover and pointer-follow need JavaScript (hydrate: visible)
